title: A scripted person is no human: their labels and corrections never confirm anything in the store
request: The other session (e2e runs kept for the store) and the owner's capture rule: every record stored, each for what it is.
spec: A workspace marked scripted (scripted.json in its folder or above it within agent_runs) gives no person label to the decision sets and no person judgement or preference to m7.
plan: Find where the store reads a person's answers as human truth.
One marker rule, as the lake's.
Apply it in the decision sets and m7; mark the scripted folders.

decisions.decision: The same marker rule as dclab_rnd.lake.harvest.scripted, in the store's keepers.
decisions.why: The lake and the store must agree on who is a human.

decisions.decision: A scripted person's label is set aside, not relabelled.
decisions.why: A test click or a written person's choice is the script's, not a measurement: it teaches nothing true about people.

decisions.decision: agent_runs/live_tests is marked as a whole.
decisions.why: Live tests play written or scripted people against a live model: the model is live, the person never is.

change: dclab_rnd/store/keepers/workspaces.py (SCRIPTED, scripted, scripted_names), dclab_rnd/store/sets/decisions.py (a scripted person's label set aside, counted once per record), dclab_rnd/store/sets/others.py (judged and preferences skip a scripted correction), tests/test_store_scripted.py (new); markers in agent_runs/journey_plays, journey_plays_before_fix and live_tests.

findings.defect: A scripted person's labels and corrections were read as a human's.
findings.scenario: In the store's sets, 55 of 404,228 examples carry a person label or judgement, some from scripted live tests (model paths, the home orchestrator); the e2e runs (91 test clicks in one run) and 589 written people's plays were about to add many more.
findings.cause: The store ranks a person's label first and makes each correction a human judgement, wherever it was recorded.
findings.fix: The marker; the decision sets and m7 skip a scripted person.

findings.defect: A record placed in two sets was counted twice as set aside.

measurements.name: affected tests
measurements.result: 13 tests in 5 files pass (scripted, decision sets, other sets, keepers, store check); 924 workspaces marked scripted
limits: the store's sets are rebuilt at the next store run

outcome: Only real people's choices confirm a label or judge a proposal; every scripted record is still kept, for what it is.
lessons: Who answered is part of the label: a test's person is not a person.
